The system block sits at position 0 and is recomputed every request — here it is about %1$d tokens. Anything volatile inside it (a date placeholder, a world-info entry that toggles on keywords) invalidates the whole cached prefix. Keep volatile content out of the system prompt; keyword-triggered world info belongs at the bottom of the chat.

Read-only preview assembled by the same code path as a real request, then split by source. Nothing is saved and no request is sent. Items marked synthetic exist only for the request.
Not counted here: the encoded size of images/documents (their count is shown instead), and request protocol wrapping (role/content, tool_calls and similar). Token counts use a real BPE tokenizer (cl100k_base): exact for OpenAI-compatible models, a close approximation for others - the character heuristic is used only until the vocabulary finishes loading at startup. Tool schema is counted separately from the actual wire shape of the current provider.
